content:
alex_lee: quick ping — PR #4523 updates HSM authz hooks and audit-log emission. i'm blocked on merge until we get one more security approval. https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4523

maria_g: taking a look now. is this only adding an audit field or also changing existing event names?

alex_lee: only adding a new field `kms_request_id` and toggling audit-level to `detailed` for KMS ops. no event renames. config change lives in `deploy/kms/audit.yaml`.

samir_khan: quick skim — main thing i want to validate is we aren't logging any long-lived secrets. can you paste the snippet of the emitter config?

alex_lee: sure, excerpt:
```yaml
emitter:
  format: json
  fields:
    - timestamp
    - user_id
    - action
    - resource
    - kms_request_id  # opaque id, no secret contents
  redact:
    - secret
    - token
```

rachel_ops: :eyes: looks fine at a glance. two quick asks: 1) add a unit test to ensure redact rules are applied during serialization, 2) mention the change in the SOC2 audit notes doc (ops/compliance/audit-notes.md)

maria_g: also please confirm keystore access is still limited to the same roles — the policy diff looks unchanged but double-checking.

alex_lee: confirmed — IAM policy unchanged. i'll add the test and update the audit note. estimated +30m.

samir_khan: i can give formal approval after the unit test lands. if you want to force-merge earlier, @sec_oncall_bot we still require an explicit security approval per the repo rules, correct?

sec_oncall_bot: reminder: repo `platform` requires 2 approvals for security-sensitive PRs. Automated checks: 6/6 passing.

rachel_ops: ok, thanks. @maria_g once alex pushes the test can you give the final approval if it looks good?

maria_g: will do, ping me here when pushed.

alex_lee: pushed the test + updated audit note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4523/files#diff-...

maria_g: quick pass — test covers redact rules, LGTM. approving now.

samir_khan: approving as well. :thumbsup:

alex_lee: incredible, thanks all. merging after CI finishes. i'll follow up in #eng-sre if we see any unusual audit-volume after rollout.

rachel_ops: thanks for the fast turnaround. :)
